promotions.name: Stadtwerke Bruehl
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Bruehl electromobility page explicitly labels direct payment by credit card and the FAQ explicitly describes QR-based Ad-Hoc-Laden. For Stadtwerke Bruehl charging stations the anonymous/direct tariff is 2.00 EUR start fee plus 0.60 EUR/kWh, VAT included. Blocking fee is 0.10 EUR/min from minute 241. The first-party page explicitly scopes exceptions from the blocking fee to Parkplatz am Schloss, Parkhaus am Krankenhaus, and all private charging points. This preserves the station-scope exceptions rather than inferring a network-wide fee rule.

stillPartialChecked.name: Stadtwerke Schwerin
stillPartialChecked.reason: Current first-party page gives m8mit direct-payment tariff 0.702 EUR/kWh gross for four DC 50 kW points at Im Eckdrift 43-45 plus 0.10 EUR/min blocking fee after 4 h capped at 12 EUR, but this evidence is location-scoped. Keep partial until canonical estate coverage confirms no additional SWS public EVSE require another tariff. Treat as m8mit-family candidate.

nextSafeAction: Continue current first-party easy queue with Weimar and Herrenberg only if complete fee/scope coverage is explicit. In parallel enumerate m8mit-family canonical members, beginning with Schwerin estate coverage, then switch to chargecloud/Mobilithek B1/B3/B6 batch resolution.
